title: A Christmas Angel Match
overview: Christmas angels used to working alone to bring “destined soulmates together” over the holidays, are unexpectedly paired; soon, their “clashing styles – and the undeniable spark growing between them – complicate their mission.”

title: Believe in Christmas
overview: Two best friends travel to Christmasland, a place filled with hope and miracles.

title: The Secret Gift of Christmas
overview: Bonnie is a personal shopper who helps her new, widowed client Patrick reconnect with his young daughter. Though Bonnie and Patrick's ideas of shopping couldn't be more different, she is determined to get Patrick and his daughter everything on their wish list.
